label: FP
reason: The reported path involves user-supplied cookie data being decoded from URL format into bytes, then passed through ESAPI's encodeForHTML() method which performs HTML entity encoding. This encoding neutralizes XSS payloads when written to an HTML context via PrintWriter.println(). The CodeQL alert incorrectly flags this as XSS because it does not account for the presence of the effective mitigating function call (encodeForHTML) on the exact same data flow.

evidence.note: User cookie value flows through decode -> getBytes -> new String -> encodeForHTML before reaching println sink
